errors.routingConflict: A Windows route bypasses Lumen. Retry the connection or check competing routes.
errors.tunAdapterTimeout: Windows could not start the VPN adapter. Check for another active VPN, then try again.
errors.ruleUpdateFailed: Could not apply the rule to the current connection. The connection was kept; retry the change.
errors.timeout: Operation timed out. Check the status and retry.
errors.invalidSubscription: Check the name and URL or key format.
errors.subscriptionFetchFailed: Unable to download subscription. Check internet connection or URL availability.
errors.hwidNotSupported: The subscription service did not accept the device identifier. Update the application or contact your subscription provider.
errors.hwidDeviceLimit: Device limit reached for this subscription. Remove an old device in your dashboard or contact your provider.
errors.hwidUnavailable: Failed to create or load device identifier. Restart the application and try again.
errors.invalidRule: Enter a domain without a path or an application name ending in .exe, and select a server.
errors.storage: Could not read or save settings. Check storage access.
errors.geoDataMissing: GeoIP/GeoSite databases are missing or corrupted.
errors.invalidGeoTag: Invalid tag. Use Latin letters, digits, _, -, !, @
errors.unsupportedProtocol: The server uses a protocol or transport Lumen does not support yet. Pick another server. (UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL)
errors.coreNotFound: Xray or Wintun files are missing. Extract the whole archive again and check your antivirus quarantine. (CORE_NOT_FOUND)
errors.coreStartFailed: Xray could not start: an antivirus blocked it or local ports are busy. Exclude the Lumen folder from your antivirus and retry. (CORE_START_FAILED)
errors.coreCrashed: Xray stopped unexpectedly. An antivirus or another VPN client may have closed it. Connect again. (CORE_CRASHED)
errors.coreStopFailed: Could not stop Xray. Restart Lumen. (CORE_STOP_FAILED)
errors.coreRollbackFailed: The update failed and the previous connection could not be restored. Connect manually. (CORE_ROLLBACK_FAILED)
errors.tunFailed: Could not bring up the LumenTun adapter: the administrator helper did not start or exited. Turn off other VPNs, allow the administrator prompt and retry. (TUN_FAILED)
errors.tunNetworkUnreachable: The server answers and connections and DNS through LumenTun work, but HTTPS checks fail. Antivirus HTTPS scanning (Kaspersky, ESET, Avast) usually causes this. Turn it off or exclude Lumen, then reconnect. (TUN_NETWORK_UNREACHABLE)
errors.tunTrafficBlocked: The server answers, but Windows connections through LumenTun do not get out. Another VPN, a virtual adapter (Radmin, ZeroTier, Hamachi, Hyper-V) or a firewall usually causes this. Turn them off and reconnect. (TUN_TRAFFIC_BLOCKED)
errors.tunDnsFailed: Connections through LumenTun work, but Windows cannot resolve site names: DNS does not answer. Pick another DNS server in Lumen settings (for example 1.1.1.1) and reconnect. (TUN_DNS_FAILED)
errors.permissionDenied: TUN mode needs administrator rights and the Windows prompt was declined. Connect again and choose Yes in the UAC prompt. (PERMISSION_DENIED)
errors.serverUnreachable: The server does not answer: it is down, blocked by your provider, or the key is outdated. Pick another server or refresh the subscription. (SERVER_UNREACHABLE)
errors.cancelled: The operation was interrupted by another action. Retry. (CANCELLED)
errors.networkChanged: The Windows network changed and the VPN was disconnected after repeated failed checks. Connect again. (NETWORK_CHANGED)
errors.networkError: Could not check the network. Check your internet connection. (NETWORK_ERROR)
errors.busy: Lumen is busy with another operation. Wait a few seconds and retry. (BUSY)
errors.liveSwitchFailed: Could not switch servers without reconnecting. Disconnect and connect to the new server. (LIVE_SWITCH_FAILED)
errors.ipUnavailable: Could not detect the public IP address. The connection may still work; check a site in your browser. (IP_UNAVAILABLE)
errors.invalidConfig: Xray rejected this server's configuration. Refresh the subscription or pick another server. (INVALID_CONFIG)
errors.dnsUnavailable: Could not read the Windows DNS servers. Check the network adapter settings. (DNS_UNAVAILABLE)
errors.metricsUnavailable: Traffic statistics are unavailable. The connection is not affected. (METRICS_UNAVAILABLE)
errors.alreadyRunning: Lumen is already running. Open it from the tray icon. (ALREADY_RUNNING)
errors.updateFailed: Could not check for or install the update. Check your internet connection and retry. (UPDATE_FAILED)
errors.updateUnavailable: You already have the latest version. (UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE)
errors.logConsoleFailed: Could not open the Lumen log. (LOG_CONSOLE_FAILED)
errors.notificationFailed: Windows did not show the notification. Check notification permissions. (NOTIFICATION_FAILED)
errors.platformUnsupported: TUN mode is not available on this platform yet. Choose System Proxy under Working Mode. (PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED)
errors.autostartUnavailable: Move Lumen to the Applications folder to open it at login. (AUTOSTART_UNAVAILABLE)
errors.GEO_DATA_MISSING: GeoIP/GeoSite databases are missing or corrupted.
errors.INVALID_GEO_TAG: Invalid tag. Use Latin letters, digits, _, -, !, @

presets.requiresProxy: Requires an active subscription or server for VPN rules
presets.switchModeDesc: Preset applied. To take effect, it is recommended to switch the application mode to "Rules".
presets.russiaOptimizedDesc: Russian services, the local network and other traffic stay direct. Blocked sites, YouTube, Telegram and Discord use the VPN.
presets.bypassBlockingDesc: Routes blocked resources through VPN, all other traffic remains direct.
presets.russiaDirectDesc: In Rules mode, Russian services and LAN connect directly. Combine with a bypass preset; this preset alone does not send other traffic through the VPN.
presets.subtitle: Routing scenarios

rules.title: Rules
rules.invalidGeoTag: Invalid tag. Use Latin letters, digits, _, -, !, @ (up to 128 characters)
rules.addHint: Choose what the rule applies to, then enter an address or app name and select a server.
rules.domainHint: Domain only, without https:// or a path. For example, example.com
rules.applicationHint: Application file name ending in .exe. For example, Discord.exe
rules.finalDetails: Used when no rule above matches
rules.typeFinalDesc: Where all remaining traffic goes. For example: everything through a server in Malaysia, while a couple of sites and apps go direct.
rules.finalHint: Everything no rule above matches goes here. Sites and apps with a Direct rule still skip the VPN.
rules.switchModeDesc: Everything else only works in Rules mode. Turn it on now?
rules.typeDomainDesc: Traffic of the site and all its subdomains goes through the chosen server.
rules.typeApplicationDesc: All traffic of the chosen programs on this computer goes through the chosen server.
rules.typeGeositeDesc: Ready-made domain lists by category: services, countries, blocklists.
rules.typeGeoipDesc: Location by IP address: country, region, city, coordinates, provider, ASN.
